statement: XGBoost relies more on self-rated health (A2) than on depressed mood (D2).
target: Learner PFI of each predictor under marginal permutation, which includes combinations absent from the data: the expected increase in held-out log loss for XGBoost fitted to training sets of 15,274 rows (9/10 of the sample).
analytic_distribution: Task shild_life_satisfaction: 16,971 rows, 27 features, outcome life_satisfaction (positive class discontent); missing values in C1, D10, D11, D15, D16, D17, D2, D4, D6, D8, E1, E17, E2, E5_a, F15, G1, J17, J2, J4, M2, and M6, handled by the learners.
scientific_use: scientific description; no decision about individuals
explanation_design: 10 resampling iterations (custom) with the same splits for all learners: one fit per training set; each predictor permuted 20 times in the held-out fold; increases averaged over permutations and folds.

provenance.time_basis: date the claim was derived from the results
provenance.selection_basis: Formulated after inspecting the held-out PFI of XGBoost; self-rated health (A2) has the larger average PFI of the two.
